Assignment Title: Gym Membership Fee

Assignment Question:
A gym offers three membership plans. Write an interface Chargeable with the method baseFee(), and an interface Discountable with the constant MAX_LOYALTY_DISCOUNT = 500.0, the abstract method planDiscount(), and a default method loyaltyDiscount(int years) that returns 100 rupees for every completed year but never more than MAX_LOYALTY_DISCOUNT.
Three classes implement both interfaces:
MonthlyPlan — base fee Rs. 1500.00, plan discount 0.
QuarterlyPlan — base fee Rs. 4200.00, plan discount 5 percent of the base fee.
AnnualPlan — base fee Rs. 15000.00, plan discount 12 percent of the base fee.
Total discount = plan discount + loyalty discount. Amount payable = base fee − total discount.
Read the plan name and the number of completed years, then print the base fee, the total discount and the amount payable.
Sample Input
QUARTERLY 1
Sample Output
Base Fee = 4200.00
Discount = 310.00
Amount Payable = 3890.00
Input Format
A single line with two tokens: the plan name (MONTHLY, QUARTERLY or ANNUAL) and the number of completed years.
Output Format
Line 1: Base Fee = <value>
Line 2: Discount = <value>
Line 3: Amount Payable = <value>
All values printed with exactly two decimal places.
Constraints
0 ≤ years ≤ 40
The loyalty discount is capped at Rs. 500.00, which is reached at 5 completed years.
MAX_LOYALTY_DISCOUNT is declared inside an interface, so it is implicitly public static final and can never be assigned inside a class.
Every method that implements an interface method must be declared public.
Test Cases

	Expected Output

	Base Fee = 1500.00
Discount = 0.00
Amount Payable = 1500.00
	
MONTHLY 3
	Base Fee = 1500.00
Discount = 300.00
Amount Payable = 1200.00
